requirements.title: Raw Sensor Logging to SD Card
requirements.description: The FSW shall log all raw sensor measurements to the SD card during the mission.
requirements.rationale: FT1 mission role requires preservation of raw sensor data for post-flight analysis and Trick simulation anchoring.

requirements.title: Live In-Flight Navigation Estimation
requirements.description: The FSW shall execute a live navigation algorithm in flight to estimate and propagate nav state.
requirements.rationale: FT1 is a nav-evaluation flight; the navigation algorithm must run on flight hardware in real time.

requirements.title: Live Telemetry Downlink Over LoRa
requirements.description: The FSW shall transmit live telemetry over the LoRa radio during the mission.
requirements.rationale: FT1 requires real-time ground visibility into vehicle state and recovery beaconing post-landing.

requirements.title: No Actuation on FT1
requirements.description: The FSW shall not command any vehicle actuator during the FT1 mission.
requirements.rationale: FT1 scope is nav evaluation and sim anchoring; actuation is explicitly out of scope.

requirements.title: IMU Sample Rate
requirements.description: The FSW shall sample the IMU at 200 Hz throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM-fixed IMU rate to bound boost-phase motion (~13 G, 500 ms) and support nav at 100 Hz.

requirements.title: IMU Accelerometer Range
requirements.description: The FSW shall configure the IMU accelerometer range to plus or minus 16 G.
requirements.rationale: Flight envelope reaches 13 G; 16 G range provides margin without saturation during boost.

requirements.title: IMU Gyroscope Range
requirements.description: The FSW shall configure the IMU gyroscope range to plus or minus 2000 degrees per second.
requirements.rationale: Maximum rotation rate envelope for FT1; 2000 dps avoids saturation during boost and recovery.

requirements.title: Altimeter Sample Rate
requirements.description: The FSW shall sample the barometric altimeter at 20 Hz throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM-fixed rate sufficient for apogee detection (~600 m) and nav baro fusion at 20 Hz cadence.

requirements.title: GPS Sample Rate
requirements.description: The FSW shall sample the GPS receiver at 5 Hz throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM-fixed GPS rate matches FGPMMOPA6H capability and supports horizontal nav bounding.

requirements.title: Static Compile-Time Schedule
requirements.description: The FSW shall execute all applications on a static schedule fixed at compile time.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: no dynamic rate changes; deterministic TDM scheduling for repeatable nav and logging.

requirements.title: No Sensor Downsampling for Logging
requirements.description: The FSW shall log each sensor at its full sample rate without downsampling.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: preserve raw fidelity for post-flight analysis and Trick sim anchoring.

requirements.title: Nav State Output Rate
requirements.description: The FSW shall publish navigation state estimates at 100 Hz during the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM-fixed nav output cadence supports telemetry, AFM, and consistent post-flight analysis.

requirements.title: Sixteen-State Navigation Estimate
requirements.description: The FSW shall produce a navigation estimate containing position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and accelerometer and gyroscope biases.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined nav state composition: 3 position, 3 velocity, 4 quaternion, 3 accel bias, 3 gyro bias.

requirements.title: Navigation Position Bound to GPS
requirements.description: The FSW shall keep the navigation position estimate within a configured horizontal distance of the GPS fix.
requirements.rationale: PM-required black-box divergence sanity bound; numeric threshold lives in design, not requirement.

requirements.title: Navigation Validity Flag
requirements.description: The FSW shall publish a navigation validity flag indicating whether the nav estimate is currently trustworthy.
requirements.rationale: PM-required observable state so consumers (telemetry, post-flight) can gate use of nav output.

requirements.title: Automatic Flight Phase Detection
requirements.description: The FSW shall automatically detect boost, apogee, descent, and landing transitions from pre-launch initial phase.
requirements.rationale: PM-required AFM capability; pre-launch is the at-power-on initial phase per SW-REQ-AFM-002; algorithm choice deferred to design.

requirements.title: Flight Phase Published to Software Bus
requirements.description: The FSW shall publish the current flight phase on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: phase is an observable consumed by telemetry and logging via the bus.

requirements.title: Flight Phase Transition Timestamp Accuracy
requirements.description: The FSW shall timestamp each flight phase transition within one second of post-flight ground-truth determination.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined AFM acceptance tolerance for FT1 closure based on log analysis ground truth.

requirements.title: Telemetry Downlink Rate
requirements.description: The FSW shall transmit telemetry packets over the LoRa radio at 2 Hz.
requirements.rationale: PM-fixed telemetry rate balancing LoRa link budget against ground-station observability.

requirements.title: Telemetry Packet Content
requirements.description: The FSW telemetry packet shall include timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health.
requirements.rationale: PM-specified packet content covering mission state required for ground monitoring and recovery.

requirements.title: Continuous Telemetry Coverage
requirements.description: The FSW shall transmit telemetry continuously from power-on until external power is removed.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: continuous coverage including post-landing recovery beaconing.

requirements.title: SD Card Log Content
requirements.description: The FSW shall log all raw sensor samples, navigation state, and flight phase events to the SD card.
requirements.rationale: PM-specified log content enabling post-flight analysis and Trick sim anchoring.

requirements.title: Machine-Parseable Log Format
requirements.description: The FSW shall write SD card log records in a machine-parseable format.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: format details deferred to design but parseability is a requirement.

requirements.title: Verbatim Raw NMEA Logging
requirements.description: The FSW shall log raw GPS NMEA sentences verbatim to the SD card.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: preserve unmodified GPS source data for post-flight reconstruction.

requirements.title: New Log Run Per Power-On
requirements.description: The FSW shall create a new log run on each power-on.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: each power-on starts a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.

requirements.title: Monotonic Microsecond Time Base
requirements.description: The FSW shall stamp every record using monotonic microseconds since startup as the single time base.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: one canonical time source across all records ensures cross-record alignment.

requirements.title: Per-Sample Timestamping
requirements.description: The FSW shall include a timestamp on every individual sensor sample record, not only batch headers.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: per-sample timestamps required for accurate post-flight nav reconstruction.

requirements.title: GPS UTC Time Logging
requirements.description: The FSW shall log a GPS UTC time record whenever the GPS receiver provides UTC time.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: enables post-flight alignment of monotonic time to absolute UTC.

requirements.title: Power-On Self-Test
requirements.description: The FSW shall execute a power-on self-test probing each sensor device once at startup.
requirements.rationale: PM-required POST so the operator knows pre-flight whether all sensors are responsive.

requirements.title: POST Result Logging
requirements.description: The FSW shall log the per-sensor POST pass-or-fail result to the SD card once at startup.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: POST result is a one-shot record persisted on the SD card.

requirements.title: Continuous Sensor Health Bitmap
requirements.description: The FSW shall publish a per-sensor health bitmap continuously throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM-required ongoing health observability included in every telemetry packet and log.

requirements.title: Operator Health Indicator LED
requirements.description: The FSW shall drive a physical LED reflecting all-healthy versus error state for the operator.
requirements.rationale: PM-required pre-flight visual go/no-go indication for the operator on the pad.

requirements.title: Sensor Read Failure Continuation
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue operating when a sensor read fails.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: never halt mission on sensor failure; continue execution.

requirements.title: Navigation Degraded-Input Continuation
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue propagating navigation with reduced inputs when sensor inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: nav must never crash; degrade gracefully when sensors drop.

requirements.title: SD Write Failure Continuation
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue attempting SD card writes after a write failure.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: SD failures must not halt mission; retry writes.

requirements.title: Radio Failure Continuation
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue all other operations after a telemetry transmission failure.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: radio loss must not impair logging or nav.

requirements.title: No Auto-Reboot During Mission
requirements.description: The FSW shall not autonomously reboot or reset itself during the mission.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: failures flag and continue; FIDR is out of scope for FT1.

requirements.title: Geodetic Position Frame
requirements.description: The FSW shall represent position as WGS-84 geodetic latitude and longitude in degrees with altitude in meters.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined coordinate convention for FT1 telemetry, logging, and nav output.

requirements.title: Height-Above-Ellipsoid Altitude Reference
requirements.description: The FSW shall reference reported altitudes to the WGS-84 ellipsoid (HAE).
requirements.rationale: PM decision: HAE chosen as the unambiguous reference shared with GPS output.

requirements.title: NED Velocity Frame
requirements.description: The FSW shall express velocity in the North-East-Down (NED) frame.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined aerospace-standard velocity frame for FT1 nav and telemetry.

requirements.title: Body-to-NED Quaternion Attitude
requirements.description: The FSW shall represent attitude as a unit quaternion (w, x, y, z) rotating from body frame to NED.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined attitude representation for FT1 nav output and telemetry consumers.

requirements.title: SI Units Throughout
requirements.description: The FSW shall use SI units for all logged and downlinked physical quantities.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: globally SI to eliminate unit-conversion ambiguity.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The FSW POSIX build shall be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build.
requirements.rationale: PM-required so Trick simulation exercises the same software paths as flight.

requirements.title: Deterministic Execution
requirements.description: The FSW shall produce deterministic outputs given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.

requirements.title: Trick Simulation Integration
requirements.description: The FSW shall be runnable inside a NASA Trick simulation accepting simulated IMU, baro, and GPS inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required closed-loop SITL capability anchored to FT1 sensor suite.

requirements.title: Operational on Power-On Without Arming
requirements.description: The FSW shall become fully operational immediately at power-on without any external arm signal.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: no arming step; power-on equals mission start.

requirements.title: Run Until External Power Removed
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue executing until external power is removed, never initiating its own shutdown.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: no FSW-initiated shutdown; operator controls end of mission via power.

requirements.title: Post-Landing Recovery Beacon
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue transmitting 2 Hz telemetry indefinitely after landing until power is removed.
requirements.rationale: PM-required recovery beaconing supports locating the rocket after landing.

requirements.title: FT1 Flight Verification Artifacts
requirements.description: The FSW FT1 verification shall produce SD log, telemetry transcript, operator video, signed checklist, and recovered hardware.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined required closure artifacts for FT1 flight-side requirements.

requirements.title: No Dynamic Memory Allocation After Boot
requirements.description: The FSW shall not perform dynamic memory allocation after boot completes.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR: heap is forbidden post-boot to ensure deterministic memory behavior.

requirements.title: No Runtime Polymorphism After Init
requirements.description: The FSW shall not employ runtime polymorphism after initialization completes.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR: dynamic polymorphism only permitted during initialization for vtable wiring.

requirements.title: No RTTI
requirements.description: The FSW shall be built without runtime type information.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR: RTTI is prohibited; enforced via -fno-rtti compiler flag.

requirements.title: No Thrown Exceptions
requirements.description: The FSW shall not throw C++ exceptions.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR: exceptions are prohibited; enforced via -fno-exceptions compiler flag.

requirements.title: Unit Test Line Coverage
requirements.description: The FSW unit test suite shall achieve 100 percent line coverage.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR: 100% line coverage mandated; no branch coverage requirement applies.

requirements.title: Prior Log Run Preservation
requirements.description: The FSW shall preserve prior log runs on the SD card until externally wiped.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: protect prior flight data against accidental overwrite between runs.

requirements.title: POST Result Downlink
requirements.description: The FSW shall downlink the per-sensor POST pass-or-fail result over the radio once at startup.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: POST result is a one-shot record visible on the ground station at startup.

requirements.title: Body Axes Convention
requirements.description: The FSW shall define body axes as X-forward, Y-right, and Z-down.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined aerospace-standard body axis convention for FT1 nav and telemetry.

requirements.title: Mark Sensor Unhealthy on Read Failure
requirements.description: The FSW shall mark a sensor unhealthy when a read from that sensor fails.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: failed sensors are flagged unhealthy in the published health state.

requirements.title: Navigation Validity False on Missing Inputs
requirements.description: The FSW shall set the navigation validity flag false when required nav inputs are unavailable.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: validity flag must reflect degraded input state so consumers gate use.

requirements.title: Flag SD Card Unhealthy on Write Failure
requirements.description: The FSW shall flag the SD card unhealthy when an SD card write fails.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: SD write failures are surfaced via the published health state.

requirements.title: Flag Radio Unhealthy on Transmission Failure
requirements.description: The FSW shall flag the radio unhealthy when a telemetry transmission fails.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: radio transmission failures are surfaced via the published health state.

requirements.title: AFM-Loss Tolerance
requirements.description: The FSW shall continue executing applications at their static rates when flight phase detection is unavailable.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: loss of AFM does not halt the mission; apps run at static rates regardless.
